questions.q: What has begun to be removed in Belgrade?
o: Illegal terraces of cafés and restaurants
questions.e: In the video: "ubrzano uklanjanje nelegalnih bašta kafića i restorana" — accelerated removal of illegal terraces of cafés and restaurants.

questions.q: When can inspectors issue a removal order?
o: A few hours after an inspection
questions.e: In the video: "mogu izdati nalog za uklanjanje u roku od samo nekoliko sati nakon kontrole" — can issue a removal order within only a few hours after an inspection.

questions.q: What does the City Assembly's decision introduce?
o: Zero tolerance for illegal occupation of public areas
questions.e: In the video: "uvodi se nulta tolerancija na nelegalno zauzimanje javnih površina" — zero tolerance for the illegal occupation of public areas is introduced.
In the video: "protiv prekršilaca će biti izricane i znatno uvećane novčane kazne" — considerably increased fines will also be imposed on offenders.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: komunalni *inspektori* mogu izdati nalog za uklanjanje
nulta tolerancija na nelegalno *zauzimanje* javnih površina

questions.e: Prekršilac — an offender; prekršilaca — gen. pl.
The set phrase stupiti na snagu — "to come into force", acc.: na snagu.
Uklanjanje (of what?) takes the genitive pl.: bašta.

questions.q: Odlukom ___ grada uvodi se nulta tolerancija

questions.e: The subject kazne is fem. pl., like its agreeing adjectives: uvećane novčane kazne.
